info.title: RePassCloud Licensing API
info.description: Admin API: bearer tokens (`rpl_pat_…` / `rpl_svc_…`) only — no cookies, no browser login. Machine API v1: binding contract from LICENSING-SERVER-BRIEF.md; authenticated by activation key / client secret. Errors: admin `{error:{code,message,details?},requestId}`; machine `{error,message}`.
